gate_legend.G0: Viable named candidate; identity and own R1/R2 evidence, current development decision allows route.
gate_legend.G1: Admissible data, exposure, source/license/calendar/task/support and additional-dataset selection.
gate_legend.G2: Complete family, estimand, three pertinent methods, assumptions, multiplicity and decision/calibration.
gate_legend.G4: Compatible pilot/covariances; finalR/T,MDE,power≥.90 per contrast and joint reported.
gate_legend.G5: Actual prospective registration, fixed protocol and sealed confirmation.
gate_legend.G6: Adequacy of same candidate and required saved inputs.
gate_legend.G7: Generalization, robustness, ablation and sensitivity under justified applicable design.
gate_legend.G8: Complete reports/resources/reproducibility; scientific accreditation remains evaluator act.
